meta.name: CCNL Industria Turistica (Federturismo Confindustria)
meta.sector: turismo — alberghi, campeggi, villaggi e strutture ricettive

sources.title: A1 and D2 confirmed at 01/05/2026. Intermediate levels derived via parametric ratio and independently verified to <EUR 0.02.

notes.text: CCNL H05B — Federturismo Confindustria. Conglobated model. 9 levels: D2-D1-C3-C2-C1-B2-B1-A2-A1. Divisor 172, 14 months. Function allowances: A1+75 EUR, A2+70 EUR (14 months). Seniority 36-month cadence, max 6.
INPS: uses 2026-terziario.json (TaxSector.TERZIARIO). Same classification as H052 turismo-federalberghi.
SALARY VALUES: parametric derivation verified to <0.02 EUR accuracy across all levels. A1 and D2 taken directly from source; all others derived via stable level-coefficient ratios.

PRE-2025 NOT MODELLED: the CCNL H05B renewal starts Jan 2025; series begins 2025-01-01. Prior CCNL salary tables exist but are out of scope for the current engine version (coverage starts at renewal date). This is a deliberate scope decision.

SENIORITY CADENCE: file uses 36 months. Search for H05B 2025 suggests 'ogni due anni di servizio' (24 months) for this contract (lavoro-economia.it H05B, adapt.it). Contrasts with Confcommercio turismo (H05A) which changed from 36 to 48 in 2024 renewal. Cadence needs confirmation from primary CCNL H05B text; if 24 months, file needs correction. Maximum scatti: 6 (confirmed).

limitation.remediation: Confirm the seniority cadence (36 or 24 months) against the H05B text.

notes.text: APPRENTICESHIP: under_classification 2 levels below destination is a contract-specific rule not representable in the engine schema (single under_levels value, not per-destination-level). Modelled as 100% passthrough by design.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: TRATTAMENTO INTEGRATIVO SPECIALE (L. 199/2025 art. 1 cc. 18-20, Gazzetta Ufficiale text, https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/atto/serie_generale/caricaArticolo?art.codiceRedazionale=26A00149&art.dataPubblicazioneGazzetta=2026-01-21&art.flagTipoArticolo=0&art.idArticolo=1&art.idGruppo=1&art.idSottoArticolo=1&art.idSottoArticolo1=10&art.progressivo=1&art.versione=1, page sha256 e05f6f864509f87e7488cdae075fe3a1f2632f6f4577b87ee05479a1ed193c1d): from 1 January to 30 September 2026 the workers of the esercizi di somministrazione di alimenti e bevande (L. 287/1991 art. 5) and of the 'comparto del turismo, ivi inclusi gli stabilimenti termali', with employment income of 2025 not above 40,000 EUR, receive 'un trattamento integrativo speciale, che non concorre alla formazione del reddito, pari al 15 per cento delle retribuzioni lorde corrisposte in relazione al lavoro notturno e alle prestazioni di lavoro straordinario [...] effettuate nei giorni festivi'. The employer pays it 'su richiesta del lavoratore' (c. 20), a fact the request has no field for: the engine does not pay it, so the net pay of a worker who asked for it is understated.

limitation.remediation: Add the worker's request of c. 20 to the request, pay 15% of the night and holiday overtime pay of the run as a credit, then remove this note.

reviews.scope: The paga base nazionale conglobata (art. 110) of the nine levels against the Federturismo circular of 16 January 2025 that prints the tables agreed in the renewal of 21 December 2024.
findings: Federturismo Confindustria, a signatory, prints in its circular of 16 January 2025 the paga base nazionale conglobata of art. 110 'condivise' by the parties for 01/01/2025, 01/06/2025, 01/05/2026 and 01/04/2027 (PDF pp. 1-2, rows A1-D1 on p. 1, D2 on p. 2): the 36 minimi of the file are checked against the general table, not the separate tables of the imprese di viaggi e turismo e congressi (different tranches) or the aziende alberghiere minori (art. 178).
The file's values were derived parametrically from A1 and D2 (an aggregator); 11 of them differ by one cent from the printed table and are corrected.
The ruleset names this source, published by Federturismo Confindustria, a signatory: source_type contracting_party.
